title: Part Sale notes: notified like any note, no Customer Visible, View-gated
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user, on the build under test. The Notifications Center feature is on.
  2. A teammate you tag on a Part Sale note; and a user WITHOUT "Work Orders -> View" and WITHOUT "Part Sales -> View".
custom_steps:
1. Tag a teammate on a Part Sale note and check their inbox and email.
  2. On the Part Sale New Note dialog, look for a "Customer Visible" checkbox.
  3. As the user without either View permission, try to add a Part Sale note and check whether Part Sale notes appear in their inbox.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A user who can see a Part Sale note is notified of it in the inbox and by email like any other note.
  • A Part Sale note does not offer the "Customer Visible" checkbox - Part Sale notes are internal to the shop.
  • A user without "Work Orders -> View" and without "Part Sales -> View" cannot add a Part Sale note and does not see Part Sale notes in the inbox.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10252 (S9, Notes on a Part Sale); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S9; design board PartSaleNotes; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R4: “A user who can see a Part Sale note is notified of it in the inbox and by email like any other note.”
  • S9-N1: “A Part Sale note does not offer the "Customer Visible" checkbox; Part Sale notes are internal to the shop.”
  • S9-N2: “A user without 'Work Orders -> View' and without 'Part Sales -> View' cannot add a Part Sale note and does not see Part Sale notes in the inbox.”
